description:
FILED s473f (Opus, 2026-09-09).  PRE-EXISTING.

    open(my $p, "-|", "/bin/sh", "-c", "exit 3") or die;

    perl : runs /bin/sh with those arguments, no shell in between
    PCL  : compile-time death --
             Error while parsing arguments to defmacro p-open:
               too many elements in ($p "-|" "/bin/sh" "-c" "exit 3")
               to satisfy lambda list (fh mode &optional filename):
               between 2 and 3 expected, but got 5

`p-open`'s lambda list is (fh mode &optional filename).  perl's LIST form is
the SAFE spelling of a pipe open -- it is what code uses to avoid the shell --
so the failure mode is that safety-conscious code does not compile.  The same
question applies to `open(FH, "|-", LIST)`.

Found while probing #1247 (b): the probe had to fall back to a single shell
string.  Minimal repro above.
subject: `open(FH, "-|", LIST)` -- the multi-argument (no-shell) pipe open -- is an ARITY error in p-open
